description: A shell script for testing 'git apply --3way' functionality, including setup, applying patches with and without --3way, conflict resolution, and binary patch application.

methods.name: print_sanitized_conflicted_diff
methods.description: Outputs a sanitized diff of the current HEAD, removing index lines and diff markers.

methods.name: test_apply_with_3way
methods.description: Tests applying a patch with --3way, comparing the result to a conflicted merge.

methods.name: test_apply_with_3way_favoritism
methods.description: Tests applying a patch with --3way and different merge strategies (--ours, --theirs, --union).
